resolutions.note: Measured NRV wear evidence supports a bounded wear-state monitoring concept; no universal wear or compensation threshold is promoted.
Measured flow and pressure-drop evidence supports cooling-channel hydraulic-resistance health interpretation; contamination magnitude remains tool/fluid specific.
Independent real-mould fouling measurements corroborate the same bounded hydraulic-resistance concept; model-derived sediment thickness remains derived.
Direct barrel, nozzle and cavity pressure measurements support explicit pressure-domain separation; fitted viscosity indices remain derived and study-specific.
Real corrosion failure forensics are retained as maintenance evidence, but post-failure SEM/EDS/XRD/XPS do not create an online sensor signature.
The already-counted primary study supports direct measured-moisture reasoning without adding a new primary-study identity.
